title: Promise Thread Card
purpose: Help children distinguish Genesis 3:15 from later passages that develop the rescue promise.
body_markdown:
# Promise Thread

Place these cards in order along a string.

- Genesis 3:15 - the serpent will be crushed.
- Hebrews 2:14-15 - Jesus defeats the one with the power of death.
- Romans 16:20 - God will crush Satan under the church’s feet.

## Teacher key

Each passage adds information. Do not say Genesis 3:15 explicitly contains every later detail.
